thesis: Eureka invites both players to place permanents onto the battlefield, but deck construction can make the apparently equal exchange overwhelmingly one-sided.

canonicalIdentity.currentOracleText: Starting with you, each player may put a permanent card from their hand onto the battlefield. Repeat this process until no one puts a card onto the battlefield.
canonicalIdentity.identityNotes: Original Legends 1994-06-01 credited to Kaja Foglio; printing ID remains from accepted snapshot. Modern Oracle text is not misidentified as original printed wording. Verified focused mechanics source: https://mtg.wtf/card/leg/185/Eureka

playbook.commonMistakes: Players take turns choosing permanents; a player who declines a turn can still place one later if the process continues. The sequence ends only after all players consecutively decline to put a card onto the battlefield, and cards put onto the battlefield are not cast.
